scope.market_definition: The organic milk market encompasses the production, distribution, and sale of milk sourced from cows that are raised according to organic farming standards. Participants include dairy farmers, processors, and various distribution channels such as wholesalers and retailers, operating globally.

This layer includes the various channels through which organic milk is distributed to retailers and consumers.
This layer includes companies that provide services related to the organic milk market, such as logistics and marketing.
